rationale: The transfer account now records two distinct surfaces for the same explicit request: the demotion race reported successful futures in all twenty attempts, the four-member entry-point harness reports 'leadership transfer in progress' on every attempt, and the flag probe with the transfer flag clear reports no error. The demotion-race figure is what lets the account say a nil future is reachable for an ineligible target, and it rests on a single run of a randomised loop. Repeating that fixed experiment from its retained inputs adds a second run of the same twenty attempts, so the account can say whether the nil-future surface is reproducible there as well, or whether the in-progress surface has been masking it.
